_comment: auto-pr-skill guardrails for Claude Code. The installer MERGES these permission entries into ~/.claude/settings.json (global) or <repo>/.claude/settings.json (project); it never clobbers your other settings. The deny list is the safety net that keeps a weak model (and read-only worker subagents) from pushing, opening/merging PRs, or hitting the network directly. Real pushes happen only inside lib/submit_pr.sh, which the deny rules do not intercept.
